extraction_method: Chrome DevTools MCP. Opened https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard, which redirects to https://arena.ai/leaderboard (same product). Re-attempted the 2026-09-02 method first (fetch(url, {headers:{RSC:"1"}}) against /leaderboard/{arena}/{category}) but every such request now returns HTTP 404 with a generic Cloudflare/GitHub-Pages-style not-found body, even though the same paths load fine as normal navigations — the RSC-only fetch appears to require a matching next-router-state-tree header that a bare fetch cannot supply. Switched to fetching the plain document (ordinary fetch(path), no special headers) for each /leaderboard/{arena}/{category}[-no-style-control] route; Next.js embeds the full RSC flight payload in the HTML as a series of <script>self.__next_f.push([id,"..."])</script> chunks. Those chunks were extracted with a bracket-depth-aware scanner (string-literal aware, since the flight text sits inside a JS string literal), concatenated in document order, evaluated as JS array literals via `new Function` to recover the real (unescaped) flight text, then the object following the first "leaderboard":{ (or "snapshot":{ for the agent arena) marker was brace-matched out and JSON.parsed. Because the page is server-streamed, an early fetch can race a still-loading Suspense boundary and yield a truncated document with no leaderboard marker; each route was retried up to 5 times (cache: 'no-store') until the marker was found — in practice every route succeeded on the first attempt. Each leaderboard payload's own "id" field (a path like leaderboard-sets/public/leaderboards/{slug}/leaderboard-snapshots/latest) was used to derive the per-record "benchmark" slug, exactly reproducing the internal slugs from 2026-09-02 (e.g. image_edit, image_to_webdev) even though they differ from the human-facing arena names used elsewhere in this file. The agent arena payload shape is {lastUpdated,totalSessions,totalObservations,modelCount,rows,signals} and was extracted the same way. Factuality ratings came from GET /nextjs-api/factuality/ratings?arenaSlug=text&category={cat}, a plain JSON endpoint (unchanged from 2026-09-02, fetched directly with no RSC parsing needed).
notes: lmarena.ai now redirects to arena.ai. source_url is kept as the requested lmarena.ai URL; per-record source_url points at the live arena.ai page.
No login, CAPTCHA or Cloudflare interstitial was encountered. The leaderboard is fully public.

Verification that the extracted payload matches what the browser rendered: for text|overall|style_control the fetched payload gives claude-fable-5 rating 1507.5857493966353 (rounds to 1508), ratingLower/Upper 1502.61/1512.56, votes 27013, inputPricePerMillion 10, outputPricePerMillion 50, contextLength 1000000 — same shape and same top model/organization as the 2026-09-02 capture, consistent with a live, continuously-updating leaderboard rather than a stale snapshot.

The ranking-mode control has three options: Style Control, Factuality, None. URL suffix "-no-style-control" returns the raw (styleControl:false) leaderboard. Both style_control and raw variants were captured for the text and vision arenas. The document and search arenas declare hasStyleControl:true but their pages already serve styleControl:false and expose no style-control URL, so only the raw variant exists for them. All remaining arenas have hasStyleControl:false, so their single variant is labelled "raw".

Factuality is not a leaderboard but a penalty-weight sweep (weights 0/25/50/75/100) giving rating/ratingLower/ratingUpper/rankLower/rankUpper per model key. It is stored verbatim in raw.json under factuality_text_ratings for all 29 text categories, but is NOT expanded into normalized.json because it has no single canonical score per model. It is only served for the text arena.

Every value in normalized.json is copied verbatim from the site payload. Fields the site does not provide (votes for the agent arena, context_window and pricing for many image/video models, dates for arenas without voteCutoffISOString) are omitted, never estimated.

Arena route slugs differ from arena slugs: image-to-code -> /leaderboard/code/image-to-webdev, video-to-video -> /leaderboard/video-edit. The code arena (WebDev) uses internal leaderboard ids prefixed "webdev".
ci for standard arenas is the absolute rating interval {lower, upper} from ratingLower/ratingUpper. The agent arena only publishes a symmetric half-width, stored as {half_width}.
Non-spec fields kept because the task asked for the underlying data: model_key, rank_upper, rank_lower, style_control, model_url, and (agent only) sessions / observations.

changes_vs_20260902: (1) The 2026-09-02 extraction method (RSC-header fetch against the App Router route) no longer works — it now 404s; today's scrape instead parses the self.__next_f flight chunks out of the plain server-rendered HTML for the same routes, recovering an identical payload shape (verified against the one field-level cross-check quoted above). This is a mechanism change only, not a data-source change: same routes, same JSON shape, same fields. (2) row_count increased from 25958 to 25959 (+1), leaderboard_count unchanged at 124.
